name: gmail
description: Save sent and received Gmail emails and attachments in Bonobo Senate Files. Read them in Mail, and write Gmail drafts with the chat agent.

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: Show what the member sees in Mail right now: the account, the mailbox folder, the open email or draft, and the newest emails in the list.

tools.name: open_email
tools.description: Open one email in the Mail page and return its headers and text. Use a path from get_view or from the Files tools, for example /emails/me-example-com/2026/10/18-hello-18f2a.md. The answer has a threadId. To read the whole conversation, search Files for frontmatter.gmail-thread-id:<threadId>, then read each file it finds. senderWarning is set when Gmail's DMARC check of the sender failed; tell the member before you trust the email. A null senderWarning does not prove the sender is real.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List the member's Gmail drafts made in Bonobo Senate, newest first. Bodies are not listed. Call read_draft to read one.

tools.name: read_draft
tools.description: Read one Gmail draft's recipients, subject and text without opening it in the Mail page. Refused while the member is typing in the draft.

draftId.description: A draftId from list_drafts or create_draft.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Write a new Gmail draft and open it in the Mail page so the member can review it. Saved as a Gmail draft. It is not sent; only the member can send it. To reply, pass the email's path as replyToPath.

replyToPath.description: Files path of the email this draft answers.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Change a Gmail draft and open it in the Mail page. Fields you leave out stay the same. Saved as a Gmail draft. It is not sent; only the member can send it. Refused while the member is typing in the draft.

draftId.description: A draftId from list_drafts or create_draft.

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a Gmail draft that you changed last. Gmail deletes it for good. A draft the member changed last is refused; ask the member to delete it. Refused while the member is typing in the draft.

draftId.description: A draftId from list_drafts or create_draft.
